# Website Health Report

> Free website scanner that detects broken links, missing pages, and technical issues in minutes.

Website Health Report crawls any public website and produces a prioritised health report. It
detects eight categories of issues — broken internal links, broken external links, broken images,
redirect chains, missing page titles, thin pages, slow pages, and homepage availability — ranking
each by severity (critical, important, minor) and linking it back to the page where it was found.

One-off scans are completely free, require no account, and check up to 1,000 pages and 5,000 links.
Weekly automated monitoring costs $9/month per site (currently discounted from $19/month) and scans
up to 2,000 pages and 10,000 links.

## Key pages

- [Home / Scanner](https://webhealthreport.pages.dev/): Enter any URL to start a free scan
- [FAQ](https://webhealthreport.pages.dev/faq): Detailed answers about the scanner, issue types, monitoring, and pricing

## What it checks

| Issue | Severity | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Broken internal links | Critical | Links within your site returning 4xx/5xx errors |
| Broken external links | Important | Outbound links to pages that no longer exist |
| Broken images | Important | Images that fail to load |
| Redirect chains | Minor | URLs that redirect through two or more hops |
| Missing page titles | Important | Pages with a blank or absent <title> tag |
| Thin pages | Minor | Pages with fewer than ~100 words of body text |
| Slow pages | Minor | Pages taking over 3 seconds to respond |
| Homepage unavailable | Critical | Root URL is unreachable or returns an error |

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Pages | Links |
|---|---|---|---|
| One-off scan | Free | 1,000 | 5,000 |
| Weekly monitoring | $9/month per site | 2,000 | 10,000 |

## Technical notes

- Scans fetch raw HTML (same as Googlebot's first crawl pass) — no JavaScript rendering
- Most sites complete in 30 seconds to 2 minutes
- Health score 0–100: A (90–100), B (75–89), C (60–74), D (40–59), F (<40)
- Results can be exported as CSV
- No public API — scanning is initiated via the web UI only
